title: Authorize canonical sales order execution evidence at every record entry
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: For canonical single-order execution routes, resolve live enabled nondeleted identity and existing sales-order menu with existing SalespersonDataScopeService, then authorize the persisted CustomerId before reading any timeline, progress, return, invoice, receipt or finance evidence. Centralize a finite canonical-order guard; no permission grants or legacy Oid inference. Include list/detail and bounded explicit-id evidence summaries where the same order selector is exposed; reject mixed foreign ids before evidence derivation, without counts or partial rows revealing inaccessible orders.

Preserve existing operational evidence calculations, currency/unit separation, null-as-unknown and response DTO contracts. Foreign or missing orders have the same controlled non-disclosing error. Preserve lawful authorized historical access and ordinary workflows; no schema, source writes or report migration/entry switch. Each denied request is bounded and logged without financial payloads/secrets. This is securing operational record entry points, not publishing another report.

Real isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover own/foreign order on every affected endpoint, disabled/deleted/revoked/module-missing identity, mixed explicit ids, legal privileged access and unchanged source/stock/finance on denial. Assert permitted derivations retain existing partial shipment/returns/invoice/receipt semantics. Relevant unit regressions and safe Release/full unit validation; report browser limitation accurately.

implementation_evidence: SalesOrderController Timeline, FinanceReconciliation, Progress, ReturnImpact and invoice/receipt evidence single-record routes call static derivation helpers without ResolveScopeAsync or live module authorization. GetPaged/GetById have only the inherited scope resolver. ERP410/411 cover separate legacy api/v2 controllers, not canonical api/sales-orders; knowing a foreign canonical Id exposes shipment, return and finance evidence.
